entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Futami Okitama Shrine  is a Shinto shrine in Ise, in Mie Prefecture, Japan. It is known for its proximity to the Meoto Iwa rocks, which serve as torii gates for believers offering prayers to the sun.
